prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity desktop web interface concept image for the independent Chinese entertainment module “天赋测试”, aspect ratio 16:10, approximately 1440 × 900. This is a visual refinement of the supplied existing page screenshot, not a new product or an unrelated style. Render the finished UI itself edge-to-edge, not in a device, browser mockup or room.

REFERENCE ROLE: The input image is the existing preview. Keep its clean system sans-serif Chinese typography, fine outlines, gently rounded corners, soft small shadows, outline buttons, small circular left/right arrows and pagination dots. Keep the FOUR existing challenge names and actual game meanings. Change the composition and colors as described below.

LAYOUT IS THE PRIMARY INSTRUCTION:
A compact single-row header near the top: a small 22px burst icon and small approximately 20px “天赋测试” brand at left; modest “挑战大厅”, “排行榜” navigation, and “中文 / EN” at right. Thin neutral separator. Remove the large hero title entirely. DO NOT include “挑一项，看看你的天赋。” or any replacement slogan, large heading, eyebrow, marketing banner or oversized branding. One optional quiet 14px helper line “选一张卡片，开始挑战。” is sufficient, close to the card area.
The four cards are the clear main visual, a pleasantly uneven hand of playful challenge cards. They must have conspicuously DIFFERENT TOP and BOTTOM levels and independent small tilts, rather than a uniformly aligned grid. From left to right: mint reaction card starts about y=205 and tilts −3 degrees, butter-yellow memory card starts about y=145 and tilts +2 degrees, lilac reasoning card starts about y=230 and tilts −2 degrees, sky-blue focus card starts about y=175 and tilts +3 degrees. Card widths roughly 290px with gaps 25–35px, differing heights around 405–475px. All four complete cards and all buttons fully visible. They do not overlap or obstruct text. A casual asymmetrical rhythm, like individually placed physical cards, with crisp real UI geometry. Generous comfortable canvas, but no huge empty hero area.
Background is clean warm off-white. Cards are gently saturated pastel mint, warm butter yellow, soft lavender, airy sky blue, substantially more colorful than gray without neon or gradients. Very fine deeper tinted borders, light restrained shadows, about 9px radius. Dark near-black readable text. The colored surfaces carry the visual delight.
Each card has compact 24px Chinese title, one concise description, a small meaningful game diagram at center, discreet tags, then outline “试一试 →” button and underlined “看玩法” link. Avoid dense paragraphs or dashboard statistics. Keep hierarchy clear and card actions easy to find. Diagram scale modest about 90–110px, no giant artwork.

REAL CARD CONTENT, exact Chinese:
1 “反应力”; “等变绿，立刻点击。”; small radiating burst and green circular signal diagram; tags “5 轮” and “毫秒”.
2 “记忆力”; “看亮起的格子，按顺序点回来。”; simple 3 × 3 grid diagram with two highlighted green cells; tags “九宫格” and “顺序记忆”.
3 “思考速度”; “从数字之间，找到下一步。”; clean diagram “2  4  8  ?”; tags “60 秒” and “数字规律”.
4 “专注度”; “看颜色，别被文字带走。”; word “红” printed in unmistakable blue ink with small colored answer marks; tags “60 秒” and “颜色干扰”.
Every card has “试一试 →” and “看玩法”.

Keep circular previous/next controls subtly at left and right outside the card deck; a tiny centered four-dot pagination row below the lowest card. A quiet footer “交互预览 · 本次成绩不保存” at lower left, with a thin divider. No fake scores, users, standings, achievement claims, percentiles or scientific ability claims. No extra decorations, mascots, blobs, textures, paper tears, 3D objects, floating confetti, gradients, giant icons or oversized labels. Polished understated and playful frontend screenshot, not a poster. Faithful precise Chinese text.
